summary: Compiling the reporter's waterfall loop as vs_6_0 hoists the wave-sensitive buffer load out of the loop because CGHLSLMS.cpp's EmitHLSLCondBreak only engages the dx.break protection (PR #2795) for PS/CS/Lib; ps_6_0 on the identical source stays protected. Unchanged since dx.break was introduced (2020-03-30, d3af7f123): reproduces on every stable release from v1.5.2010 through v1.9.2607 and on main-debug (89e2f98e2); v1.4.1907 predates the mechanism for every stage and is invalid evidence, not a clean result.
title: Incorrect code for waterfall loop in VS shader
